title: XChoice: Explainable Evaluation of AI–Human Alignment in LLM-based Constrained Choice Decision Making

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating and comparing structural decision weights for constrained time allocation between human survey data and LLMs prompted with different racial identities (e.g., Black, Asian, White).
Comparing mechanism-based decision parameters for daily time allocation between human baselines and LLMs prompted with married versus unmarried individual profiles.
Evaluating deviations in LLM-generated time allocation decisions compared to human data using structural parameter estimation across male and female profiles.
Comparing structural decision weights for time allocation trade-offs based on varying education and weekly income levels between human baselines and LLM outputs.
Estimating and comparing the effect of continuous age variables on time allocation trade-offs between empirical human survey data and LLM-generated decisions.
